title: XOR-Trellis: Ultra-Low-Complexity Dequantization and Curvature-Aware Hadamard-Free LLM Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.00432v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Trellis-coded quantization enables high-dimensional compression of large language model (LLM) weights at ultra-low bit widths without the exponentially large codebooks required by conventional vector quantization. Practical deployment, however, presents two challenges: reconstructing compressed weights at sufficient parallel throughput to avoid making dequantization an inference bottleneck, and maintaining quantization accuracy without costly incoherence transformations. We address these challenges with two complementary techniques. First, we introduce an ultra-low-complexity trellis dequantizer that uses a structured, hardware-efficient state-to-value mapping while preserving diverse reconstruction choices for trellis search. Second, we reformulate discrete trellis path optimization with a curvature-aware objective that reflects model sensitivity directly in the original coordinate space. translated_title: XOR-Trellis：面向大语言模型量化的超低复杂度反量化与曲率感知的无Hadamard变换方法
translated_abstract: 网格编码量化能够在超低比特宽度下对大语言模型（LLM）权重进行高维压缩，而无需传统向量量化所需的指数级规模码本。然而，实际部署面临两个挑战：一是以足够的并行吞吐量重建压缩权重，以避免反量化成为推理瓶颈；二是在不使用代价高昂的非相干变换的前提下保持量化精度。我们通过两种互补技术来解决这些挑战。首先，我们引入了一种超低复杂度的网格反量化器，它采用结构化、硬件高效的状态到值映射，同时为网格搜索保留多样化的重建选择。其次，我们以曲率感知的目标函数重新构建了离散网格路径优化问题，该目标函数直接在原始坐标空间中反映模型敏感性。这些技术共同实现了高质量的
tldr: 本文提出XOR-Trellis，通过超低复杂度的硬件高效网格反量化器和直接在原始坐标空间中建模敏感性的曲率感知优化目标，实现了无需Hadamard变换的高质量超低比特大语言模型权重量化，同时避免反量化成为推理瓶颈。
en_tdlr: XOR-Trellis enables high-quality ultra-low-bit LLM weight quantization without Hadamard-based incoherence transformations by combining an ultra-low-complexity, hardware-efficient trellis dequantizer with a curvature-aware trellis path optimization objective that directly reflects model sensitivity in the original coordinate space.
